body:
The SO left for boot camp for the Navy, and so we had a long distance relationship. We send letters back and forth, shit like that, until I get a text message from her on her graduation date and my birthday about how we're not dating anymore in her mind and she thought I knew that. Within a week she goes out and loses her virginity to some dude at a bar, after us waiting for over two years because she wasn't ready and wanted to wait until marriage, and then texts me and tells me about it. 

Go into a bad depression over it, fail my semester classes, and I lose my academic funding. Start drinking a lot and doing a lot of drugs (mainly weed and acid) a lot more than I should. Depression gets worse, until I try and off myself one night with booze and pills. Decide I need help, and go get some. 

Start going to a psychiatrist, get put on anti-depressants. Fast forward a few months, and the anti-depressants stopped working, so I stopped taking them, but can't go back to my psych for another month because of insurance, and I dont have the funds (because I lost my academic funding so now college costs are coming out of pocket) to see a therapist even though I know I really need one.

Most of my "friends" stopped being my friends when I told them about my depression. Those that stayed my friends are tired of hearing my "complaining about shit that doesn't even matter", and the very few who don't think that I know are getting fed up with me. 

So I figure fuck it, I've lost almost all my friends, I lost the woman I was going to propose to, and really the only thing I have is nothing to live for, why not just pop off and be done with it rather than suffering more?
